entries.back_en: "Thou art the one who claims to be a god?"

"Thou art not a god. Thou art but a mere shadow...Something that drank of the dregs of the power of gods and believes that thus thou hast become a god too. Thou wast affected by our power and that of the others, nothing more."
"Perhaps...Perhaps the world needeth not gods? What sayest thou of this?"

"The Endless are summoned to this sphere...This changes the balance of Nature herself, flooding the world with energies both powerful and dangerous, and causes beings easily influenced by it to think they are gods..."
"Puny man doesn't make sense. I don't understand puny man. I kill puny man."
entries.note: Perde a fala truncada/gramática quebrada do original ('Me not understand'); registro/voz divergem.
